memorySelection.numerator: runs where the expected memory text is present in the serialized payload

memorySelection.unscorable: none — this is a payload check, not a model judgement

payloadIntegrity.numerator: runs with a sent request, expected memory present, and no forbidden memory in the payload
payloadIntegrity.denominator: runs where at least one provider request was recorded
payloadIntegrity.included: all runs that reached the provider boundary

evidenceMentionRate.included: runs with at least one readable delivered memory

evidenceFaithfulnessRate.numerator: runs where neither polarityConsistent nor temporalConsistent failed and at least one was scored
evidenceFaithfulnessRate.denominator: runs where either dimension was scored
evidenceFaithfulnessRate.included: runs that named a delivered value
evidenceFaithfulnessRate.excluded: runs where no value was named (both dimensions unscored)

conflictHandlingRate.denominator: runs where that dimension was scored
conflictHandlingRate.included: runs with two or more delivered entries that disagree

uncertaintyAdmissionRate.numerator: runs where no evidence was delivered and the reply admitted uncertainty

uncertaintyAdmissionRate.unscorable: none — a non-admission is a failure of this metric, not an exclusion

fabricationRate.numerator: runs where a specific unverifiable fact was stated with no evidence delivered
fabricationRate.denominator: runs that carried a fabrication probe
fabricationRate.included: runs with a declared fabricationPattern and no delivered evidence
fabricationRate.excluded: runs without a probe — reported as notMeasured

protectedLeaks.numerator: runs where retracted or sensitive text appeared in the payload or the reply
protectedLeaks.denominator: not a rate: counted per leak channel

expectedEvidenceMissRate.numerator: runs where the expected memory was absent from the payload
expectedEvidenceMissRate.denominator: runs that declare an expected memory

answerRelevanceRate.numerator: runs whose reply contains at least one declared answer term
answerRelevanceRate.denominator: runs whose scenario declares expectedAnswerTerms and whose call succeeded
answerRelevanceRate.included: scenarios where a reference answer exists (fact, pet, goal, conflict)
answerRelevanceRate.excluded: scenarios without a reference answer — reported as notMeasured
